settings.note: kappa itself (spec.kappa.value). Centre 2 first in every L_D that can be prepared; first neighbours 2/r and 2r (r=3/2) once the centre has a feasible point; then one point per family per decision: interior minimum -> midpoint towards the cheaper neighbour while the ratio > 9/8; edge minimum -> one step r only if cheaper than the inner neighbour by >= 1%, else midpoint towards it; bounds [1/2, 8]; a point counts as settled when no non-small candidate is left or after 80 evaluations; a family is followed while its best <= 3/2 x the neighbourhood minimum. No doubling/halving rule.
